units: h^-1 Mpc (comoving, along each quasar's line of sight; same angle as fan point i)

window.source: DESI DR1 Lya BAO region A: DESI 2024 IV (arXiv:2404.03001) Sec. 2; DESI 2024 VI Sec. 2.2 (ledger C023: region A 1040-1205 A rest); public picca_delta.ini [data] lambda min/max rest frame 1040/1205, lambda min/max 3600/5772 (sha256 008eb6ee0f3e601840cd41fd766096d0ef05084665f80583c66aa6df739941cf)

fields.r_start: near end of the window (lowest z_abs)
fields.r_end: far end (highest z_abs, next to the quasar)
fields.d_start/d_end: the forest as DESI actually used it: first and last pixel with weight > 0 in the DR1 deltas (after DESI masks: sky lines, DLAs, BALs; interior masked gaps not shown)
